summary.text:
We need answer only JSON list test cases. Need generate comprehensive unit tests for SELF011. At most 2 cases, max 8 steps per case. Need cover complete normal path and one important boundary. Need compact JSON.

We need reason PLC FB semantics. States IDLE, EXTEND, CLAMP, RELEASE, RETRACT, DONE. One transition per scan. Outputs match post-transition phase: Extend true in EXTEND, Clamp in CLAMP, Release in RELEASE, Retract in RETRACT, Busy active steps 1..4, Done DONE. From IDLE enter EXTEND iff Start AND RetractDone (and no Stop/Reset). Advance on matching feedback. DONE holds until Stop/Reset. Stop/Reset return IDLE clear outputs.

Need tests steps inputs, expected outputs. Reset instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial pre-state IDLE all false. Inputs level-sensitive. Need ensure at most one transition per scan.

We need complete normal path: likely sequence from IDLE -> EXTEND -> CLAMP -> RELEASE -> RETRACT -> DONE. Need include Step0 with Start true RetractDone true to enter EXTEND same scan, expected Extend true Busy true, others false. Then ExtendDone true -> CLAMP expected Clamp true Busy true Extend false, etc. Need maybe hold states? Max 8 steps. Can do:
1 IDLE start: Start=1 RetractDone=1 all done false? expected Extend=1 Busy=1, Clamp/Release/Retract/Done=0. State EXTEND. Note Start can stay true.
2 ExtendDone=1 RetractDone maybe 1? Start perhaps 0? expected Clamp=1 Busy=1 Extend=0. Need only matching feedback. If Start remains true no issue. ExtendDone true. state CLAMP.
3 ClampDone true -> Release true.
4 ReleaseDone true -> Retract true.
5 RetractDone true -> DONE expected Done=1 Busy=0 all actuator 0.
6 DONE hold: all maybe 0, expected Done=1. Good 6 steps. But note step5: RetractDone true from previous? In step4 state RETRACT and RetractDone maybe false needed? Actually step4 transition RELEASE->RETRACT if ReleaseDone=true. Input RetractDone could be true? If it is true in same scan, because at most one transition per scan, it transitions to RETRACT and outputs Retract true; doesn't immediately go DONE same scan. So can have RetractDone maybe true. But to model clean, set RetractDone false at step4, then true step5. Step5 transitions RETRACT->DONE due RetractDone true. Good. Step6 Done hold with no Stop/Reset; maybe RetractDone true? In DONE no transition. Done true.

Need boundary important: Stop/Reset overrides active state. Maybe test Reset during active. Or IDLE start blocked when RetractDone false and Stop clears. At most 8. Need one important boundary. We can choose abort/Reset mid-cycle prioritization: from active CLAMP, Reset true -> IDLE outputs clear same scan, then Start maybe true but Reset still true? Need demonstrate no transition and clear. Then after Reset false, Start true RetractDone true reenters EXTEND. But max steps. Let's design boundary case focusing Stop/Reset override and one transition per scan maybe.

Need ensure JSON only. Each step inputs dict all relevant inputs? Could include only changed? The test harness likely supplies all inputs. To be safe include all 7 input variables each step with booleans. Expected all 6 outputs. Compact. Need choose valid IDs case_1, case_2. Use JSON booleans true/false.

Let's re-evaluate normal path carefully with outputs "post-transition" in same scan. Semantics: At scan, sample inputs, read pre-state q[k], execute one transition, observe outputs at end of same scan. So if q[k]=IDLE and Start&RetractDone, transition to EXTEND, outputs Extend=true Busy=true same scan. Yes.

Step 1:
inputs Start=true Stop=false Reset=false ExtendDone=false ClampDone=false ReleaseDone=false RetractDone=true. pre IDLE. condition Start & RetractDone true -> EXTEND. expected Extend=true, Clamp=false, Release=false, Retract=false, Busy=true, Done=false.
Step 2:
Start maybe false. Stop false Reset false ExtendDone=true other done false, RetractDone maybe true or false. pre EXTEND. matching ExtendDone true -> CLAMP. expected Extend=false, Clamp=true, Release=false, Retract=false, Busy=true, Done=false.
Step3: ClampDone=true -> RELEASE. expected Release true Busy true.
Step4: ReleaseDone=true -> RETRACT. expected Retract true Busy true.
Step5: RetractDone=true -> DONE. expected all commands false Busy false Done true.
Step6: DONE hold: maybe no feedback. expected Done true, Busy false. Good. This covers normal path complete.

Boundary case: abort/reset priority and IDLE precondition maybe. Need important boundary: Stop/Reset override active and clear outputs one scan. We can test Reset during active, also Stop while DONE, and IDLE with Start true but RetractDone false remains idle. Steps max 8. Need make case meaningful.

Case 2:
Step1: from IDLE, Start=true RetractDone=false normal -> should stay IDLE all false (boundary start requires RetractDone). This tests P11 idle hold.
Step2: Start=true RetractDone=true -> EXTEND expected Extend true Busy true.
Step3: ExtendDone=true -> CLAMP expected Clamp true Busy true.
Step4: Reset=true (while CLAMP, maybe ClampDone=true) -> return IDLE clear all. Expected all false (Stop/Reset override, no transition). Good.
Step5: Reset=false, Start=false (or true?) maybe prove IDLE after reset. With Start=true RetractDone=true and Reset=false, can reenter EXTEND. But if step5 Start true RetractDone true after reset, expected Extend true. Demonstrates reset clear and restart. But "one transition per scan" reset to IDLE same scan, next scan can start. Fine.
Step6: Stop=true during EXTEND -> IDLE clear all expected. This tests Stop too. But if step5 state EXTEND, step6 Stop true, outputs false. Good.
Step7: Stop=false, Start=false -> IDLE stays clear. Expected all false. Maybe 7 steps. But need maybe Stop priority in DONE? Not necessary.

Alternatively boundary case: Test Stop/Reset overrides while Done. But important boundary is abort active. Include both Reset and Stop. At most 8, okay.

Need consider Reset true in step4: At beginning state CLAMP, Reset true, return IDLE clear all outputs. So expected all false. Do we need include ClampDone=true? If Reset overrides, yes shows override. Set ClampDone true, Reset true, to ensure transition not to RELEASE. Good.

Step5: Reset=false, Start=true RetractDone=true. Pre IDLE. Enters EXTEND. expected Extend true Busy true. Good.
Step6: Stop=true while EXTEND, maybe ExtendDone=true to test Stop overrides potential transition. Expected all false. Good.
Step7: Stop=false, Start=false. Pre IDLE, all false. Good optional. Could include maybe DONE holds until stop? Already normal path.

Need ensure expected Done false when Reset/Stop true. Yes.

Need maybe all inputs dictionary keys exactly: Start, Stop, Reset, ExtendDone, ClampDone, ReleaseDone, RetractDone. Expected: Extend, Clamp, Release, Retract, Busy, Done.

Need compact JSON. No dt_ms needed. Since timing not relevant. Could include dt_ms? optional. Omit.

Potential issue: In boundary step1, Start true RetractDone false -> stays IDLE. However Start is true; in IDLE condition requires Start AND RetractDone, so no transition. Outputs all false. Good.

Potential issue: In normal step2, if RetractDone remains true from step1? We can set it false. Inputs are sampled each scan. Fine.

Potential issue: In normal step5, when state RETRACT and RetractDone true, transition to DONE same scan. Outputs post-transition have Done=true, Busy=false, Retract=false. Yes.

Potential issue: In DONE, step6, if Stop/Reset false, holds Done true. Good. If Start true maybe no restart. Could set Start true at step6 to test DONE cannot restart. Step6 inputs Start=true Stop=false Reset=false RetractDone=true ExtendDone etc false. Pre DONE, normal & qDone -> Done true, no restart. Expected Done=true. This tests P8. Good. Include Start true in step6 to demonstrate no restart. In DONE, condition qDone holds until Stop/Reset, so outputs Done true. Good.

Need maybe normal case should include Start step0? Step1 is scan k=0. We can use Start true. Good.

Let's formulate JSON.

Need return only JSON list, no markdown. Use compact. Ensure valid. Let's produce.

Wait check step1 normal: Inputs ExtendDone false, ClampDone false, ReleaseDone false, RetractDone true, Start true. State IDLE -> EXTEND. Expected Extend true Busy true. oneAction: only Extend true. Good.

Step2 normal: Start false? Does Start matter in EXTEND? no. Set Start false to avoid weird. ExtendDone true. RetractDone false. Expected Clamp true. Busy true. Good.

Step3 normal: ClampDone true. Start false, ExtDone false. Expected Release true. Busy true. Note in CLAMP, Release output true post-transition. This matches output mirror named state. Good.

Step4 normal: ReleaseDone true. Expected Retract true. Busy true.

Step5 normal: RetractDone true. Expected Done true, all commands false, Busy false. Good.

Step6 normal: Start true, RetractDone true, Stop/Reset false, all done false. Pre DONE. stays DONE. Done true. Busy false. Good.

Boundary:
Step1: Start true RetractDone false. All outputs false. State IDLE. Good.
Step2: Start true RetractDone true. IDLE->EXTEND. Extend true Busy true. All others false.
Step3: ExtendDone true. EXTEND->CLAMP. Clamp true Busy true. Extend false.
Step4: Reset true, ClampDone true maybe Start true? Stop false. Pre CLAMP. Reset overrides -> IDLE clear all. Expected all false. Note Reset true overrides. Done false Busy false. Good.
Step5: Reset false, Start true, RetractDone true, Stop false, all done false. Pre IDLE -> EXTEND. Extend true Busy true.
Step6: Stop true, ExtendDone true. Pre EXTEND. Stop overrides -> IDLE clear all. Expected all false.
Step7: Stop false, Start false, Reset false, RetractDone maybe false. Pre IDLE stay. Outputs all false. Good.

Need be mindful: Expected should include all six outputs. In step4, Reset true, expected all false. Good.

Test case ids: "case_1_normal_path", "case_2_abort_priority"? id can be string. Fine.

Use true/false lowercase JSON. No trailing commas.

Let's output.
